name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Removing a friend library now works cleanly, also while a sync is running: the sync skips it instead of downloading it again into the library being deleted, and it disappears from the sync status list right away. Saving settings during a sync no longer breaks that sync (or a running stream or download) with "Cannot access a disposed object". Library removal recognises the plugin's own libraries more reliably and logs why it keeps one. A full resync still downloads the titles if recreating the library fails.
